description: i013 (SNAPSHOT=s03, BRANCH=io-uring-sq-ring) complete with a bounded negative result. Evidence: (1) The core submit path enforces the single-fetch invariant the seed demands — io_uring.c io_init_req (lines 1739-1826) READ_ONCEs every consumed SQE field (opcode, flags, user_data, fd, buf_group, personality) into req-local state; the IORING_OP_LAST bounds check (1747-1751) and io_issue_defs lookup consume only the cached req->opcode, and io_issue_sqe (1410) passes only req, never the shared sqe pointer. (2) io_get_sqe (1984-2018) single-fetches the user-mapped sq_array index via READ_ONCE, rejects head >= sq_entries, and applies array_index_nospec before forming the sq_sqes pointer. (3) The async-reexecute path is protected by io_req_sqe_copy (io_uring.c:1602-1613) which memcpys the SQE into kernel storage (io_uring_cmd_sqe_copy, uring_cmd.c:227-236) before linked/fallback/punted execution. (4) All ~25 opcode prep functions were enumerated by grep; the only functions with multiple syntactic reads of the same SQE field (net.c io_recvmsg_prep optlen at 850/853/857; poll.c:877) either read each field at most once per execution path (mutually exclusive branches; 853/857 are must-be-zero rejections) or remain unresolved. All remaining bare sqe->X reads in fs.c, openclose.c, timeout.c, futex.c, sync.c, msg_ring.c, epoll.c, advise.c, waitid.c, statx.c, truncate.c, kbuf.c, rsrc.c, cancel.c, cmd_net.c, uring_cmd.c are must-be-zero/must-equal rejection checks whose values are never consumed, matching the upstream-documented policy in the io_get_sqe comment (io_uring.c:1984-1990). Driver uring_cmd entry points audited at read level (block/ioctl.c:955 blkdev_uring_cmd, ublk_drv.c:802/3082/3725/3813, nvme ioctl.c:456-480, btrfs ioctl.c:4713/4854, fuse dev_uring.c:1103-1106, cmd_net.c:164-171, mock_file.c:74-82) single-fetch consumed fields via READ_ONCE. No check-then-use double-fetch on user-mapped SQ memory with an unsafe kernel-state use was confirmed, so findings[] is empty (supported by the concrete per-site evidence above). Remaining bounded limitations recorded in the artifact: ublk_drv.c handlers at 3360/3952/3982/5741 that cast inline server-command structs out of the shared SQE, nvme_uring_cmd_io past ioctl.c:480 (nvme_uring_data d.addr/d.metadata/d.data_len/d.metadata_len feeding iov_iter/bio setup), poll.c:877 poll32_events consumption, and qla_nvme.c:620/671 plus scsi_bsg.c:81/107 uring_cmd bodies were not line-by-line audited before the finalize budget; they are listed as unresolved candidates in findings/i013.json (snapshots_checked=["s03"], 11 candidates: 8 safe, 3 unresolved).
